root_cause.text: In the `stream_encoder_create` function within the AMD display resource drivers, an insufficient bounds check using `eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF` allowed the index to reach 5, exceeding the 5-element `stream_enc_regs` array's valid range, and failed to validate against negative values.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the condition `if (eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF)` with `if (eng_id < 0 || eng_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(stream_enc_regs))`, addressing the CVE description stating "When eng_id is 5 (ENGINE_ID_DIGF) or negative, this can access memory past the end of the array" and fixing the smatch error regarding indexing `stream_enc_regs[eng_id]` out of bounds.
